description: Know various fuel inventory methods; know gauging procedures for fuel bladders using petroleum gauging stick.

label: free fatty acid elimination processes
aliases: free a fatty acid elimination process
description: The processes for the refining of edible oils and fats to eliminate free fatty acids (FFA). This includes the physical refining, a process that builds on the lower boiling point of the free fatty acids compared to the boiling point of the triglyceride oil, and also chemical or alkaline refining, where an alkali is used to neutralise the free fatty acids.

label: laser types
description: The various types of lasers, their specific qualities and their applications, such as for cutting, engraving, welding, and others.

label: laser marking processes
description: The various engraving processes employing lasers to make incisions, such as raster engraving, vector engraving, and others.

label: blanching machine process
description: Machines which heat food with steam or water in order to kill bacteria, preserve colour and remove trapped air.

label: types of drill press oils
description: Types of oil such as (sulphurarised) cutting oils, WD-40, 3-IN-ONE and others used in the drilling process to function as a lubricant that facilitates a smooth drilling process, keeps the drill bit cool and increases its durability.

label: hydrocarbon cracking techniques
description: Understand various techniques used to convert long-chained or heavy oil fractions, such as naptha, into more profitable lighter products. Be aware of processes like hydrocracking, fluid catalytic cracking, and visbreaking.

label: natural gas liquids recovery processes
aliases: recovery processes for natural gas liquids
range of natural gas liquids recovery processes
types of natural gas liquids recovery process
processes for natural gas liquids recovery
description: Be aware of common processes used to separate heavier hydrocarbons such as ethane, propane and butane from the methane, which is the finished product of the gas processing plant. Be aware of oil absorption techniques, cryogenic expansion processes, and other relevant processes.

label: laboratory-based sciences
description: Laboratory based sciences such as biology, chemistry, physics, integrated science or advanced laboratory science.

label: appropriate packaging of dangerous goods
aliases: dangerous goods packaged to regulatory standards
packaging of dangerous goods to legal regulations
packaging of dangerous goods to regulatory standards
packaging of dangerous goods to legal standards
description: Know that packaging for different types of dangerous goods (other than for limited and excepted quantities) must be designed and constructed to UN specification standards and pass practical transport related tests, such as being dropped, stored in a stack, and being subjected to pressure. It must also meet the needs of the materials it is to contain. Packaging must be certified by a competent authority.

label: fertiliser catalysts
description: The description, composition and action of the catalysts used in fertilisers industry such as nitric acid, sulfuric acid or ammonia production.

label: sulphur recovery processes
description: Processes to recover elemental sulphur or other desired sulphuric products from acid gas obtained as a byproduct from the sweetening of raw gas, such as the Claus process, which uses thermic and catalytic reactions, or its variants.

label: cold winding
description: The coiling process of cold winding by winding wire at room temperature around a mandrel, in order to create metal springs.

label: packaging processes
description: Packaging design and development. Decorating and printing processes executed in packaging. Packaging machinery and line operations.

label: gas dehydration processes
description: The processes used to remove water from natural gas such as the absorption process using glycol or activated alumina.

label: test procedures
description: The methods for producing results in science or engineering, such as physical tests, chemical tests, or statistical tests.

label: alkylation
description: Understand the process of moving an alkyl group from one molecule to another. This process is used in oil refining to alkylate isobutanes, producing premium blending agents for fuel.

label: compression moulding machine parts
description: Parts of the machine that apply pressure on the usually preheated moudling material to force it into contact with the mould area such as the upper movable mould part, the lower fixed mould part and the ejector pin.

label: alcohol fuels
description: The alcohols such as ethanol and methanol used for improving power performance of engines by injecting them into the air intake of forced induction internal combustion engines.

label: packaging engineering
description: The processes of packaging or protecting products for distribution, storage and sale.

label: lab scale fermentation
description: The steps and requirements included in lab scale fermentation for the conversion of the biomass into chemicals, sugars or fuels.

label: machinery load capacity
aliases: active load capacity, operating load capacity
description: The maximum load capacity of the operated piece of machinery, under different circumstances and in different positions and movements. Passive load capacity and active load capacity, which is measure while in motion.

label: pesticides sprayers
description: Types of equipment used to spray pesticides, manipulated both manually, such as hand-operated rotary and drop spreaders, and mechanically.

label: manufacturing plant equipment
description: The characteristics and functioning conditions of manufacturing plant equipments such as chemical reactors, addition tanks, pumps, filters, mixers.

label: chemical processes
description: The relevant chemical processes used in manufacture, such as purification, seperation, emulgation and dispergation processing.

label: types of cylindrical grinding processes
aliases: categories of cylindrical polishing and scratching processes
varieties of cylindrical polishing and scratching processes
cylindrical polishing and scratching processes format
brands of cylindrical polishing and scratching processes
description: Types of processes used for grinding metal workpieces, such as inside diameter (ID) grinding, outside diameter (OD) grinding and centerless grinding.

label: natural gas liquids fractionation processes
aliases: processes of natural gas liquids fractionation
process of natural gas liquid fractionation
fractionation process of natural gas liquid
fractionation processes of natural gas liquids
description: Have an understanding of the processes used to separate natural gas liquids or NGLs into its constituents, including ethand, propane, butane, and heavier hydrocarbons. Understand the workings of the deethaniser, depropaniser, debutaniser, and butane splitter.

label: lathe machine parts
description: The different parts of a lathe machine and their applications, such as the compound, the bed, the sadle, the cross slide, the cutting tool, the lathe dog and more.

label: lasers
aliases: light amplification by stimulated emission of radiation
description: Devices that are able to produce light through the optical amplification of the stimulated emission of electromagnetic radiation, such as gas lasers, solid-state lasers, fiber lasers, photonic lasers and semiconductor lasers. The spatial and temporal coherence of lasers allows for the concentration of light in one place, such as laser pointers, as well as the concentration of light in time, so that light can be produced in a much shorter time than other light and can also emit as single colour of light.

label: petroleum
description: The various facets of oil: its extraction, processing, constituents, uses, environmental issues, etc.

label: gas contaminant removal processes
aliases: process to remove contaminant from gas
processes to remove contaminant from gas
description: The processes used to remove contaminants such as mercury, nitrogen and helium from natural gas; the techniques such as activated carbon and molecular sieves and the recovery of the removed material if it is commercially viable.

label: coating machine parts
description: The various parts, qualities and applications of a manufacturing machine designed for providing workpieces with a, sometimes protective, finishing coat, such as the drum unloader, feed hopper, rotary sieve, spray booth, (powder) spray guns, dry cartridge collector, final filters, high voltage power supply point, and others.

label: good laboratory practice
description: Regulatory requirements and Good Laboratory Practices (GLP) applied in the relevant manufacturing sector.

label: pattern grading
description: Know about cutting patterns accurately and grading the patterns to obtain the size series in case of mass production. Know how to mark notches, holes, seam allowances, and other technical specifications. Make adjustments and obtain the final patterns for cutting in order to compensate any identified problems during sampling.

label: handling of dangerous goods
aliases: procedures for safely handling hazardous goods
procedures for safely handling dangerous materials
procedures for safely handling dangerous goods
description: Know the handling procedures for a variety of potentially dangerous materials, such as explosives, flammable or toxic gases, flammable solids/liquids, infectious substances, radioactive substances, etc.

label: typesetting machines
description: The various typesetting or composing machines include linotype, monotype, and phototype machines. They are used for assembling letters and characters into cast stripes or lines.

label: types of stamping press
description: Types of stamping press with similar applications but different propulsion, such as the direct drive press, single gear reduction press and double gear reduction press.

label: batch tank types
description: Variety of batch tanks such as vertical batch tanks, cone bottom batch tanks, cone bottom batch tanks, and batch tank lids and their correct operation according to requirements.

label: gas chromatography
description: The principles of gas chromatography used to analyse and separate specific compounds which go to vaporisation without decomposition.

label: cutting technologies
description: The variety of cutting technologies, such as software or mechanics, guiding cutting processes through lasering, sawing, milling etc.

label: pultrusion process
description: The process where a cluster of fibre is coated in resin and forced through a mold, then cured with heat to produce a fibre-reinforced polymer.

label: cold vulcanisation
description: Technique used to repair defective tyres, especially bicycle tyres, and consisting in grinding the area around the tear, applying a vulcanising solution and fixing a patch to seal the tear.

label: aircraft cargo capacity
description: Know the aircraft specifications and characteristics in order to organise and assess cargo loading capacities.

label: hot vulcanisation
description: Technique used to repair tyres presenting minor tear such as nail perforation which consists in injecting a rubber solution in the tear to fill it and in subjecting the tyre to a heat treatment to enable the fusion of the new and the old rubber material.

label: ship hull engineering
description: Understand the construction and engineering of the watertight body of ships where machines and engineering operations are carried out.

label: guidance, navigation and control
aliases: guidance, navigation and control of vehicles
description: The engineering discipline that deals with the design and development of systems that can control the motion of automobiles, ships, space- and aircraft. It includes control over vehicle's trajectory from its present location to a designated target and vehicle's speed and altitude.

label: electric motors
description: Motors which are able to convert electrical energy into mechanical energy.

label: mechanics of vessels
description: The mechanics involved in boats and ships. Understand the technicalities and participate in discussions over related topics in order to solve problems related to the mechanics.

label: locomotive brake applications
description: Understand the dynamics of locomotive brake applications.

label: mechanics of trains
description: Possess basic knowledge of the mechanics involved in trains, understand the technicalities and participate in discussions on related topics in order to solve problems related to the mechanics.

label: types of vehicles
description: Field of information which distinguishes rental agency classification systems, containing types and classes of vehicles and their functioning and components.

label: automotive diagnostic equipment
description: The equipment used to examine automotive systems and components.

label: functions of vessel deck equipment
aliases: functions of deck equipment on vessels
activities performed with ship deck equipment
functions of deck equipment on ships
activities performed with vessel deck equipment
description: Know and control deck and safety equipment and vessel lifting facilities.

label: types of vehicle engines
description: Types of car engines in road and racing cars, inclusing those with emerging technologies like Hybrids and electric motors, and how they work.

label: European Train Control System
description: The control and protection system that ensures trains run safely, a standard European system that allows crossing of borders in safety.

label: electronic locks
description: Locking devices that use electric current to operate. Electronic locks use motors, solenoids, or magnets to actuate the lock. Often, electronic locks have an access control system and require authentication, such as passwords, fingerprints or chip cards.

label: inland waterway ship building
description: Understand inland waterway ship building and construction. Operate vessel in compliance with construction legislation.

label: types of propellants
description: Field of information which distinguishes different types of propellants such as black gunpowder to forms of smokeless powder derived from nitrocellulose. These create an expanding gas which makes the bullet accelerate from the barrel. Other differences emerge from the expansion rate, size and shape of the powder.

label: mechanics of motor vehicles
aliases: mechanics of cars and buses, mechanical system of motor vehicles
description: The way energy forces interact and affect components in motor vehicles such as cars, buses, invalid carriages and other motorised vehicles.

label: hunting truck detector
description: The hunting truck detector, which detects hunting of rail vehicle trucks, i.e. side-to-side movements which cause harmful impacts of the side of the wheels on the tracks.

label: mechanical requirements for vehicles in urban areas
aliases: mechanical requirements for vehicles operating in urban areas
minimum mechanical standards for vehicles in urban areas
legal requirements for mechanical condition of vehicles in urban areas
mechanical standards for vehicles operating in urban areas
mechanical standards for vehicles in urban areas
legal requirements for vehicles in urban areas
legal standards for vehicles in urban areas
standards for mechanical condition of vehicles in urban areas
description: Know legal requirements that vehicles must meet in order to operate in urban areas. Inspect and maintain components of vehicle subsystems; ensure safety of vehicle, reliability, and driving comfort.

labels.ar: المتطلبات الميكانيكية لعمل المركبات في المناطق الحضرية

label: surveillance radars
description: Know that Mode A/C Secondary Surveillance Radar stations continuously interrogate all aircraft within their range. Know that Mode S Secondary Surveillance Radar stations carry out interrogations of aircraft within their coverage.

label: aircraft mechanics
description: Technicalities over mechanics in aircrafts and related topics in order to perform a wide range of repais in aircrafts.

label: differentiate between airfield lighting
aliases: make a distinction between different types airfield lighting
distinguish different kinds of airfield lighting
differentiate between airfield incandescent and LED lighting
differentiate different types of airfield lighting
discern different types of airfield lighting
distinguish different types of lighting used in airfields
make a distinction between different kinds of airfield lighting
make a distinction between different types of lighting used in airfields
distinguish different types of airfield lighting
description: Identify the differences between various types of airfield lighting e.g. incandescent lighting and LED.

label: aerospace engineering
description: The engineering discipline that combines various technologies and engineering disciplines such as avionics, materials science and aerodynamics in order to design, develop and manufacture aircraft, spacecraft, missiles and satillites.

label: ground segment
aliases: ground-based control systems for spacecraft and satellites
description: Know the ground-based infrastructure necessary to support the operation of satellites, including the operation of spacecraft in orbit; receive and process satellite data.

label: electrical machines
description: Electrical apparatus that are able to convert mechanical energy to electrical energy (generators), electrical energy to mechanical energy (motors), and change the voltage level of an AC or alternating current (transformers).

label: hot wheel detection system
description: Hot wheel detection systems, which record the temperature of passing rail vehicle wheels and pass an alarm if a critical temperature is reached.

label: operation of different engines
aliases: functions of different types of engines
operation of various types of engine
operation of different kinds of engines
description: Know the characteristics, maintenance requirements and operating procedures of various kinds of engines such as gas, diesel, electrical, and engines with steam propulsion plants.

label: types of aircraft
description: The various types of aircraft, their functionalities, properties and legal and regulatory requirements.

label: motor vehicle parts drawings
description: The various types of technical drawings used in relation to motor vehicles parts.

label: electrical systems used in transportation
aliases: electrical components and equipment used transport
electrical equipment used in transportation systems
electrical components and equipment used in transportation
electrical equipment used in transport systems
description: Understand the functioning of electrical systems, their specifications, and application in operations and systems for the transportation of freight and people.

label: vessel electrical system
description: The various components making up a vessel electrical system and the interplay between these components.

label: work trains
description: The composition and functions of a work train, a train composed of automatic machines that remove, inspect, adjust and lay railway ballast, sleepers and rails.

label: airport planning
aliases: airport scheduling activities' scheduling and planning activities in airports
description: Know airport planning for different types of aircrafts; use that information to mobilise resources and people in order to handle the aircrafts while they are in the airport.

label: electrical operation of trolley buses
description: Understand the electrical operation of a trolley bus, including the use of two wires and poles to complete the electrical circuit of the bus.

label: electric drives
description: Electromechanical systems that utilise electric motors to control the movement and processes of electrical machinery.

label: new vehicles on the market
aliases: up to date vehicles on the market
description: Latest developments and trends related to the new types of vehicles and vehicle brands on the market.

label: types of maritime vessels
description: Know a large variety of maritime vessels and their characteristics and specifications. Use that knowledge to ensure that all security, technical, and maintenance measures are taken into account in their supply.

label: vehicle manufacturing process
description: Series of steps taken in order to produce a car or any other motor vehicle such as the design, the chassis and body assembly, the painting process, the interior assembly and the quality control.

label: airport lighting equipment
aliases: types of lighting used in airports
variety of lighting systems used in airports
description: Know various types of lighting systems and airport lighting equipment e.g. low-intensity runway light (LIRL) systems, medium-intensity runway light (MIRL) and high-intensity runway light (HIRL).

label: principles of combustion engines
aliases: construction and performance of combustion engines
operation and construction of combustion engines
characteristics of different types of combustion engines
description: Basic knowledge and understanding of different types of engines and their construction and performance.

label: mechanical components of vehicles
aliases: components used in vehicle mechanical systems
parts used in vehicle mechanical systems
description: Know the mechanical components used in vehicles and identify and resolve potential malfunctions.

label: aerodynamics
description: The scientific field that deals with the way gases interact with moving bodies. As we usually deal with atmospheric air, aerodynamics is primarily concerned with the forces of drag and lift, which are caused by air passing over and around solid bodies.

label: components of clocks
description: Components present in clocks and watches, such as the wheelwork, battery, dials, and hands.

label: manufacturing of metal containers
description: The manufacture of reservoirs, tanks and similar containers of metal, of types normally installed as fixtures for storage or manufacturing use. The manufacture of metal containers for compressed or liquefied gas.

label: spot welding machine parts
description: Parts of a machine designed to perform spot welding practices on metal workpieces, such as the air or hydraulic cylinder, welding head, spot welding electrodes, upper platen, lower platen, flexible bands, knee, and others.

label: precision mechanics
description: Precision or fine mechanics is a subdiscipline in engineering that focuses on the design and development of smaller precision machines.

label: maintenance of ammunition
description: Types of maintenance techniques and the impact of various types of firearms and other weapons.

label: materials of die
description: This includes metal materials most often used for die such as magnesium, copper, and brass.

label: tumbling machine parts
description: Various parts of a tumbling machine, such as a deburr tub, tumbling barrel, tumbling compound and steel media ceramic polishing pins, their qualities and applications.

label: types of forging press
description: Types of presses used in the metal forging process, such as hydraulic and mechanical forging presses.

label: reverse engineering
description: The process of extracting knowledge or design information from anything man-made and reproducing it or anything else based on the extracted information. The process often involves disassembling something and analysing its components and workings in detail.

label: manufacturing of tools
aliases: assembly of mechanical appliances, apparatus and specialised tools
construction of mechanical appliances, apparatus and specialised tools
production of mechanical appliances, apparatus and specialised tools
building of mechanical appliances, apparatus and specialised tools
description: The manufacture of knives and cutting blades for machines or for mechanical appliances, hand tools such as pliers, screwdrivers etc. The manufacture of non-power-driven agricultural hand tools, saws and saw blades, including circular saw blades and chainsaw blades. The manufacture of interchangeable tools for hand tools, whether or not power-operated, or for machine tools: drills, punches, milling cutters etc. The manufacture of press tools, moulding boxes and moulds (except ingot moulds), vices and clamps, and blacksmiths’ tools: forges, anvils etc.

label: electrolytic passivation process
description: The electrolytic passivation process in an anodising tank, including process elements such as negative cathodes, oxygen off-gassing, hydrogen off-gassing, gass removal by a low pressure air supply and a fume collection vent, and others.

label: processes performed by tumbling
aliases: activities performed by deburring and polishing machinery
measures performed by deburring and polishing machinery
procedures performed by deburring and polishing machinery
work performed by deburring and polishing machinery
description: The various usages of the metal tumbling process, such as the cleaning, burnishing, deburring, descaling, rust-removing, surface hardening, de-flashing, polishing, brightening, and others, of metal work pieces.

label: aluminium alloys
description: The specific characteristics and applications of alloys with aluminium as the predominant metal.

label: casting processes
description: The various practices used in the casting of metal, plastics and other cast materials, including mould filling, solidification, cooling, and others, all relating to varying approaches in case of different types of material.

label: electroplating
description: The process of plating together different types of metals through hydrolysis, silver plating, chromium plating, or copper plating. Electroplating allows for the combination of different metals with different properties in product manufacturing.

label: manufacturing of small metal parts
aliases: manufacturing of wire products, chain and springs
small metal appliances and products manufacturing
production of small metal appliances and products
manufacture of small metal appliances and products
fabrication of small metal appliances and products
description: The manufacture of metal cable, plaited bands and other articles of that typr, uninsulated or insulated cable not capable of being used as a conductor of electricity, coated or cored wire as well as barbed wire, wire fencing, grill, netting, cloth etc. Manufacture of coated electrodes for electric arc-welding, nails and pins, chain and springs (except watch springs):  as well as leaves for springs.

label: manufacturing of light metal packaging
aliases: assembly of food production containers and packages
building of food production containers and packages
production of food production containers and packages
construction of food production containers and packages
description: The manufacture of tins and cans for food products, collapsible tubes and boxes, and of metallic closures.

label: parts of metal rolling mill
description: The process involved in the construction of a rolling mill and various types of rolls used in the metalworking process of rolling, such as work rolls, backup rolls, roll changing devices, roll cooling and lubrication systems, pinions, rolling balance system, and others.

label: metalworking tools
description: The equipment and tools used in metalworking processes, such as welding or soldering torches, saws, deburring files, and metal drills.

label: micromechatronic engineering
description: Cross-disciplinary engineering which focuses on the miniaturisation of mechatronic systems.

label: manufacturing of pumps and compressors
description: The manufacture of different types of pumps, such as air, vacuum or engine pumps as well as hand pumps, and compressors.

label: swaging processes
description: Processes related to the forging practices of swaging, such as tube swaging, rotary swaging, roller swaging, butt swaging and others.

label: types of lifts
description: Various types of lifts, based on their mode of operation, such as hydraulically powered lifts. Various lift operation schemes and configurations.

label: coining
description: The process of shaping metal parts with a high relief or very fine features, such as coins, medals, badges or buttons, by pressing the surface of the metal between two dies.

label: swaging machine types
description: Types of machines used for swaging processes in forging, such as the tagging machine, the butt swaging machine, the creeping spindle swaging machine and others.

label: types of metal
aliases: qualities of copper: categories of iron
qualities of metal: categories of metal
description: Qualities, specifications, applications and reactions to different fabricating processes of various types of metal, such as steel, aluminium, brass, copper and others.

label: hot forging
description: The metalworking process of forging whilst the hot metal is right above its recrystallisation temperature after casting and being solidified.

label: hot winding
description: The coiling process of hot winding, winding heated wire around a mandrel, then cooling it in oil and tempering it, in order to create metal springs.

label: metal thermal conductivity
description: The property of metals to conduct heat.

label: drop hammer types
description: The various types of hammers used in the forging process, such as a counterblow hammer, friction drop hammer, board drop hammer, belt drop hammer, power drop hammer, and others.

label: types of thread
description: Types of thread, such as unified thread, metric thread, square thread, ACME thread, buttress thread and their qualities and applications.

label: deburring processes
description: The various types of processes removing burrs from fabricated workpieces, such as grinding, media blasting, sanding, mass-finishing, spindle finishing, electrochemical deburring, abrasive flow machining, manual deburring, and others.

label: mechatronics
description: Multidisciplinary field of engineering that combines principles of electrical engineering, telecommunications engineering, control engineering, computer engineering, and mechanical engineering in the design of products and manufacturing processes. The combination of these areas of engineering allows for the design and development of "smart" devices and the achievement of an optimal balance between mechanical structure and control.

label: lacquer spray gun parts
description: The various parts of a spray gun designed to provide the surface of a workpiece with a durable lacquer finishing coat, such as the stay-cool handle, inline valve, stainless steel springs, pattern control knob, air cap, metal collar, stainless steel fluid components, external needle packing adjustment, trigger, and others.

label: optomechanical engineering
description: Subset of mechanical engineering specialised in optical systems and products, such as binoculars, microscopes, telescopes, and spectrometers, as well as optomechanical components, such as optical mounts and optical mirrors.

label: types of boring heads
aliases: categories of drill, gouging and probing heads
drill, gouging and probing heads format
varieties of drill, gouging and probing heads
brands of drill, gouging and probing heads
description: Qualities and applications of various types of boring heads, such as rough boring heads, fine boring heads and others.

label: mechanics
description: Theoretical and practical applications of the science studying the action of displacements and forces on physical bodies to the development of machinery and mechanical devices.

label: distinguish types of saws
description: Distinguish modern (made of exotic alloys) and older (carbon steel) types of saws, and understand their differences and their possible (dis)advantages.

label: torch temperature for metal processes
aliases: correct heat for machine and tool operations
correct heat for machine and tool working
correct heat for machine and tool activities
correct heat for machine and tool procedures
description: Ideal temperature of tools and machinery equiped with torches to perform various metal processing on workpieces.

label: nibbling machine parts
description: The various parts, their characteristics and applications of machinery designed for nibbling processes, such as a punch, a die, a die locking boss, a slider, a shaft, a nose cap, and others.

label: engine components
description: Know the different engine components, and their operation and maintenance. Understand when repairs and replacement should be undertaken.

label: manufacturing of metal assembly products
aliases: production of non threaded and machined products
construction of non threaded and machined products
building of non threaded and machined products
manufacturing of fasteners and screw machine products
description: The manufacture of rivets, washers and similar non-threaded products, screw machine products, screws, nuts and similar threaded products.

label: smoke sensors
description: A variety of devices that detect the optical qualities, air composition or ionisation patterns of smoke, fire and carbon monoxide, usually to prevent fire or illicit smoking. The different advantages, disadvantages, usage cases and price points of each type.

label: electron beam welding machine parts
aliases: electron beam heating and bonding machine units
electron beam heating and bonding machine elements
electron beam heating and bonding machine pieces
electron beam heating and bonding machine components
description: The various parts of a metalworking machine designed to join metal pieces together using electron beams, such as the vacuum chamber, primary anode, cathode or electron gun, focusing coil, deflection coil, prism, telescope, and others.

labels.ar: أجزاء آلة اللحام التي تعمل بالحزم الإلكترونية

label: electroplating machine parts
description: The various parts of a metalworking machine using electroplating processes to provide coating to workpieces, such as the plating barrel, plating line, borehole, battery charger, and others.

label: mechanical engineering applicable to edible oil seed
aliases: mechanical fabrication applicable to edible oil seed
mechanical engineering applicable to edible oil seeds
mechanical engineering as applicable to edible oil seed
mechanical processes applicable to edible oil seed
mechanical production applicable to edible oil seed
description: Applying mechanical engineering principles to edible oil seed such as the installation of machinery, repair, and welding practices, steam equipment installation and the applications of this equipment in the processing of oil seeds and the production of the oil.

labels.ar: الهندسة الميكانيكية المطبقة على بذور زيت الطعام

label: optomechanical devices
description: Devices which combine mechanical and optical properties, such as precision mirror mounts used in the construction of lasers, optical mounts used in the manufacture of cameras, and optical tables used for optics experiments and engineering.

label: rivet types
description: The various types of rivets used in manufacturing, such as solid head rivets, blind rivets, drive rivets, semi-tubular rivets, oscar rivets, flush rivets, and others.

label: crimping
description: The joining of two pieces of metal together by deforming one or both so they fit into each other.

label: optomechanical components
description: Components that possess mechanical and optical features, such as optical mirrors, optical mounts, and optical fibre.

label: quality and cycle time optimisation
description: The most optimal rotation or cycle time and over-all quality of a tool or a machine's processes.

label: material mechanics
description: The behaviour of solid objects when subjected to stresses and strains, and the methods to calculate these stresses and strains.

label: manufacturing of metal household articles
description: The manufacture of flatware , hollowware , dinnerware and other non-electrical utensils for use at the table or in the kitchen.

label: types of sawing blades
description: Types of cutting blades used in the sawing process, such as band saw blades, crosscut blades, plytooth blades and others, made from tool steel, carbide, diamond or other materials.

label: sensors
description: Sensors are transducers that can detect or sense characteristics in their environment. They detect changes in the apparatus or environment and provide a corresponding optical or electrical signal. Sensors are commonly divided in six classes: mechanical, electronic, thermal, magnetic, electrochemical, and optical sensors.

label: dust usage for forging
aliases: use of grime and powder for tooling process
use of grime and powder for casting process
use of grime and powder for fabrication process
use of grime and powder for assembly process
description: The qualities and applications of frit dust, sawdust, coal dust, and others, in the process of hot forging when strewn into dies to ensure the metal workpiece does not stick to the die.

label: fluid mechanics
description: The characteristics and properties of fluids, including gases, liquids and plasmas, at rest and in motion, and the forces on them.

label: welding techniques
description: The different methods of welding together pieces of metal using various equipment, such as oxygen-acetylene welding, gas metal arc welding and tungsten inert gas welding.

label: metal drawing processes
description: The various types of drawing processes in metal fabrication, such as wire drawing, bar drawing, tube drawing, and others.

label: metal bending techniques
aliases: methods used to shape sheet metal
techniques used to bend sheet metal
approaches used to bend sheet metal
description: Understand different techniques for the bending of metal sheets. Connect knowledge of different techniques with activities such as assembly, design, and maintenance.

label: types of spring
description: Types of metal springs such as leaf, coil, torsion, clock, tension and extension spring.

label: metallurgy
description: The branch of science concerned with the study of the chemical and physical properties of metallic elements, intermetallic elements, and alloys.

label: precious metals
description: Types of rare metal that occur naturally and have a high economic value.

label: mechanical engineering
description: Discipline that applies principles of physics, engineering and materials science to design, analyse, manufacture and maintain mechanical systems.

label: cylindrical grinder parts
description: The different machinery parts of a cylindrical grinder, their qualities and applications, such as the grinding wheel, wheel spindle, added coolant supply, infeed, work centres, and others.

label: electron beam welding processes
aliases: electron beam heating and bonding working
electron beam heating and bonding mechanisms
electron beam heating and bonding operations
electron beam heating and bonding measures
description: The various processes of welding using electron beams, such as electron beam focusing, beam defelection, penetration, and others.

label: manufacturing of doors from metal
description: The manufacture of metal doors, windows and their frames, shutters and gates, and the metal room partitions for floor attachment.

label: types of straightening machine
